mapper.sql: icam55_icam_user_id AS icamUserId , icam55_reg_date AS regDate , icam55_reg_type AS regType , icam55_company_nm AS companyName , icam55_user_nm AS userName , (COALESCE(icam55_proc_add_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS procAddYn , (COALESCE(icam55_proc_modi_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS procModiYn , (COALESCE(icam55_proc_del_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS procdelYn , CASE WHEN COALESCE(icam55_proc_add_yn ,'false') = 'true' THEN 'O' ELSE '' END AS procAddYnStr , CASE WHEN COALESCE(icam55_proc_modi_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 'O' ELSE '' END AS procModiYnStr , CASE WHEN COALESCE(icam55_proc_del_yn ,'false') = 'true' THEN 'O' ELSE '' END AS procdelYnStr , CONCAT(CASE WHEN icam55_proc_add_yn = 'true' THEN coalesce(replace(icam55_proc_add_yn,'true','추가'), '') ELSE '' END, (CASE WHEN icam55_proc_add_yn = 'true' AND icam55_proc_modi_yn = 'true' THEN '/' WHEN icam55_proc_add_yn = 'true' AND icam55_proc_del_yn = 'true' THEN '/' ELSE '' END), CASE WHEN icam55_proc_modi_yn = 'true' THEN coalesce(replace(icam55_proc_modi_yn,'true','변경'), '') ELSE '' END, (CASE WHEN icam55_proc_modi_yn = 'true' AND icam55_proc_del_yn = 'true' THEN '/' ELSE '' END), CASE WHEN icam55_proc_del_yn = 'true' THEN coalesce(replace(icam55_proc_del_yn,'true','삭제'), '') ELSE '' END) AS procTypeName , icam55_appr_id AS apprId , apr01.apr01_status_cd AS apprStatusCode , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01.apr01_status_cd, 1, f_sysdate()) AS apprStatusName , icam55_reg_content AS regContent , icam55_reg_emp_id AS regEmpId , f_emp_kor_nm(icam55_reg_emp_id) AS regEmpName , icam55_proc_state_cd AS procStateCode , f_cdnm('ProcStateCode', icam55_proc_state_cd, 1, f_sysdate()) AS procStateName , icam55_proc_date AS procDate , f_emp_kor_nm(icam55_proc_emp_id) AS procEmpName , icam55_proc_note AS procNote
mapper.select: SELECT FROM icam55_icam_user LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr01 ON apr01.apr01_appr_id = icam55_appr_id WHERE icam55_icam_user_id = #{icamUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO icam55_icam_user (icam55_icam_user_id, icam55_reg_date, icam55_reg_type, icam55_company_nm, icam55_user_nm, icam55_proc_add_yn, icam55_proc_modi_yn, icam55_proc_del_yn, icam55_reg_content, icam55_reg_emp_id) VALUES (#{icamUserId}, #{req.regDate}, '1', #{req.companyName}, #{req.userName}, #{req.procAddYn}::text, #{req.procModiYn}::text, #{req.procdelYn}::text, #{req.regContent}, #{regEmpId})
mapper.update: UPDATE icam55_icam_user SET icam55_reg_date = #{req.regDate}, icam55_company_nm = #{req.companyName}, icam55_user_nm = #{req.userName}, icam55_proc_add_yn = #{req.procAddYn}::text, icam55_proc_modi_yn = #{req.procModiYn}::text, icam55_proc_del_yn = #{req.procdelYn}::text, icam55_reg_content = #{req.regContent} WHERE icam55_icam_user_id = #{req.icamUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT icam55_icam_user_id AS icamUserId , icam55_reg_date AS regDate , icam55_company_nm AS companyName , icam55_user_id AS userId , icam55_user_nm AS userName , icam55_email AS email , icam55_note AS note , icam55_appr_id AS apprId , apr01.apr01_status_cd AS apprStatusCode , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01.apr01_status_cd, 1, f_sysdate()) AS apprStatusName , f_emp_kor_nm(icam55_reg_emp_id) AS regEmpName , f_cdnm('ProcStateCode', icam55_proc_state_cd, 1, f_sysdate()) AS procStateName , icam55_proc_date AS procDate , f_emp_kor_nm(icam55_proc_emp_id) AS procEmpName , icam55_proc_note AS procNote FROM icam55_icam_user LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr01 ON apr01.apr01_appr_id = icam55_appr_id WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(icam55_company_nm, icam55_user_nm, icam55_proc_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) AND icam55_reg_type = #{regType} AND icam55_reg_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} ORDER BY icam55_reg_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO icam55_icam_user (icam55_icam_user_id, icam55_reg_date, icam55_reg_type, icam55_company_nm, icam55_user_id, icam55_user_nm, icam55_email, icam55_proc_stop_yn, icam55_reg_emp_id) VALUES (#{icamUserId}, #{req.regDate}, '2', #{req.companyName}, #{req.userId}, #{req.userName}, #{req.email}, 'true', #{regEmpId})
mapper.update: UPDATE icam55_icam_user SET icam55_reg_date = #{req.regDate}, icam55_company_nm = #{req.companyName}, icam55_user_id = #{req.userId}, icam55_user_nm = #{req.userName}, icam55_email = #{req.email} WHERE icam55_icam_user_id = #{req.icamUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO icam55_icam_user (icam55_icam_user_id, icam55_reg_date, icam55_reg_type, icam55_company_nm, icam55_user_nm, icam55_user_id, icam55_proc_stop_yn, icam55_reg_emp_id, icam55_email) VALUES (f_create_seq(), #{row.regDate}, '2', #{row.companyName}, #{row.userName}, #{row.userId}, 'true', #{row.regEmpId}, #{row.email})
mapper.select:
SELECT icam55_icam_user_id AS icamUserId , icam55_company_nm AS companyName , icam55_user_id AS userId , icam55_user_nm AS userName , icam55_email AS email , icam55_proc_date AS procDate , icam55_stop_month_period AS stopMonthPeriod , icam55_state AS state , icam55_del_date AS delDate , icam55_unstop_date AS unstopDate , icam55_mng_emp_nm AS mngEmpName , icam55_note AS note FROM (SELECT * , CASE WHEN icam55_stop_Day_period > 90 AND icam55_del_date IS NULL AND icam55_unstop_date IS NULL THEN '삭제대상' WHEN icam55_unstop_date IS NOT NULL THEN '정지해제' WHEN icam55_del_date IS NOT NULL THEN '삭제' ELSE '정지' END AS icam55_state FROM (SELECT * , f_get_datediff(icam55_proc_date, f_sysdate()::date, '2') AS icam55_stop_month_period , f_get_datedif (icam55_proc_date, f_sysdate()::date, 'D') AS icam55_stop_Day_period , f_emp_kor_nm(icam55_mng_emp_id) AS icam55_mng_emp_nm FROM icam55_icam_user WHERE icam55_proc_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND icam55_proc_state_cd = #{procStateCode} AND icam55_reg_type = '2') t) t WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(icam55_company_nm, icam55_user_id, icam55_state, icam55_user_nm, icam55_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
AND icam55_stop_Day_period >= '90' AND icam55_del_date IS NULL AND icam55_unstop_date IS NULL
ORDER BY icam55_proc_date DESC
